field_updates.detail: Figure 2. Forward Current vs. Forward Voltage, RED trace (linear 0-100 mA vs 0-5 V; no temperature printed on figure, tables are TJ = 25 °C). Read points: 1.00 mA @ 1.799 V (resid +2.4 mV); 2.00 mA @ 1.842 V (resid -2.3 mV); 5.00 mA @ 1.919 V (resid -3.2 mV); 10.00 mA @ 2.006 V (resid +1.2 mV); 15.00 mA @ 2.074 V (resid +3.1 mV); 20.00 mA @ 2.133 V (resid +1.6 mV); 25.00 mA @ 2.185 V (resid -3.0 mV). Cross-check: model VF(20 mA)=2.131 V vs stated typ 2.10 V (+31 mV); Table 3 "Red 1.8 2.1 2.6" V @ IF = 20 mA (p3). Method: Curve read from the PDF vector path itself (pdftocairo -svg), axes calibrated from the drawn gridline coordinates; read points interpolated on the drawn centreline (log I). Least-squares fit of V = N*Vt*ln(I/IS) + I*RS (linear in N*Vt, N*Vt*ln IS, RS), Vt = kT/q at 25 C = 0.02569 V. Fit 7 points 1.00-25.0 mA, rms 2.5 mV. Window sensitivity: windows 0.5/1/2/5-25 mA give N 2.07-2.92, RS 7.3-9.0 ohm. IS, N and RS are strongly correlated and must be used together as one set; individually they are not identified by this curve. If used in a .model with TNOM=27 C, re-reference IS or set TNOM=25.
field_updates.scope: Avago/Broadcom ASMB-MTB0-0A3A2 RGB; red_IS for the OHMNI simulation model (fit to the datasheet's own data); not a guaranteed limit
